bestSkills.awsDescription: I love leveraging the power of AWS services. Every new service I master brings me closer to the AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate certification.
bestSkills.jupyterDescription: I use Jupyter to test ideas and iterate on problems, which is incredibly practical. I particularly enjoy the ability to explore data, experiment with code, and take notes within the same environment.
bestSkills.pythonDescription: Proficiency in Python programming for various applications, from web development to data analysis, with a focus on clean code and automation.

bio.introduction: Full-stack developer transitioning to data engineering, I come from diverse backgrounds — graphic production, design, front-end, and back-end. What these experiences have in common: each time, I learned quickly, independently, and to the point of mastery.
bio.skills: I am rigorous and methodical. I learn in depth rather than on the surface; I structure before acting and deliver work I am proud to sign. These qualities don't depend on a stack — they precede all the tools I've learned and all those I will learn.
bio.keyPlayer: What motivates me is understanding how systems actually work — then making them clearer, more efficient, and more useful.
